currentResult: The explicit unqueried catalog state is implemented and component-verified: GREEN01 passed 13/14 with one failing synthetic observed-control ID (c-unqueried); GREEN02 changed only that test fixture ID and passed 2/2. Across both GREEN batches, 14 distinct relevant methods passed. RED01 did not reach tests because of test-source compile errors; RED02 exposed a genuine executor expectation failure and also had a wrongly routed legacy projection setup failure; RED03 passed its positive control and failed both unqueried-state checks. Managed run05 posted the exact latest presentation but failed with empty answer effectReference; its actual supplied post-upload capture is unknown. Diagnostic run06 (test-only bounded 16 KiB trace) also posted exact oracle bytes and confirms the fifth request received a fresh, untruncated capture saying “Upload accepted; file received.” The model quoted it but cited only the navigation URL, classified upload as information, and included a modified timestamp unsupported by selected-page evidence; host rejected the answer. No controlled workflow is fully accepted.
limitations: Managed model run01 did not navigate; its initial planner exchange had no valid assistant message. Run03 navigated to the local fixture and made a listFiles call, but passed invalid first-page cursor "[]" and ended unableToComplete with zero POSTs.

The earlier one-POST dispatcher result came from a scripted planner fixture and proves only chooser/executor dispatch plus duplicate suppression. Managed run05 is separate model-driven evidence: it sent one external-oracle-matched POST, but did not satisfy task completion.

The app-owned browser profile is ephemeral; a default-account Drive login and remote readback remain untested.

Run05’s actual supplied post-upload capture remains unknown. Run06 confirms fresh page text in that diagnostic run only; the model quoted it but supplied unsupported evidence references and a modified timestamp, so the host rejected completion. Do not infer a timing race or stale capture for run05.

The direct experimental planner remains default-off. The production profile is ephemeral; page chooser observation does not prove remote success; stale selection has no automatic recovery at any candidate count; browser projection is main-frame-only; catalog scope is Downloads-only; a TOCTOU gap remains.
No Drive/mail/live-account workflow, phone choice interaction, full controlled E2E pass, production readiness or model promotion is established.

Run06 differs from run05 by test-only bounded page-capture tracing. Its trace establishes the capture supplied to the model in this test, but the unsupported answer evidence and failed terminal assertion leave the complete workflow unaccepted.
Next: minimally connect file-supply completion to typed evidence and require answer references supported by fresh page capture. The run06 artifacts do not support adding a timing delay.
